title: 메타팩토리 · 적응가공 가공기 상태 감시
description: 적응가공 가공기 4대 — 주축 부하·진동·AE·베어링 온도·공구 마모 → 엣지 AI 이상 점수·RUL·판단 (metafactory/machmon/v1)

list.name: machine
list.label: 가공기
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "raw", tag: "asset", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "machine", start: -1d)

target.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "alert") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "warn") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "act") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

targets.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine" and r._field == "anomaly" and r.asset =~ /^${machine:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.asset })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine" and (r._field == "rul_tool_min" or r._field == "rul_spindle_min") and r.asset =~ /^${machine:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.asset + (if r._field == "rul_tool_min" then " 공구" else " 주축") })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])
